name: Prologue
summary: Outset Island to the first Forsaken Fortress visit: from waking up on the lookout to Tetra's gossip stone message.
notes: Partial: the Forsaken Fortress steps between entering (0x0801) and the gossip stone (0x0520) are not mapped, and the forest has unplaced flags. See 'unplaced'.

steps.label: Aryll wakes Link on the lookout
evidence: Aryll type 3 exists only while 0x2A80 is off: daNpc_Ls1_c::decideType, d_a_npc_ls1.cpp:1443

steps.label: Grandma gives the Hero's Clothes

switches.why: spawn switch of TALE_DEMO and TALE_DEMO2 (LinkRM EVNT)

evidence: walk-up to Grandma: daNpc_Ba1_c::wait_0, d_a_npc_ba1.cpp:1408-1418; LinkRM spawn 200 starts TALE_DEMO
tale.stb demo data: d_a_demo00 flag table index 1 = 0x2A80 (d_a_demo00.cpp:654)
0x2A80 off = casual clothes: d_a_player_main.cpp:12345
switch 0x02 in area 11 is on in every catalog save after the prologue
steps.seen: Talking to Grandma the first time (owner's account).

steps.label: Aryll's birthday: the Telescope
evidence: omedeto: walk-up to Aryll, d_a_npc_ls1.cpp:1929-1933; get_telescope follows
no flag: the Telescope is the only record; Aryll's state comes from it (wait_action1, d_a_npc_ls1.cpp:2124-2140)
steps.warn: 0x0001 on without the Telescope puts Aryll in her finished state and nothing gives the Telescope again.

steps.label: Looking at the postman through the Telescope
evidence: telescope_proc sets 0x0310 when message 0xBC2 closes: d_a_npc_ls1.cpp:1831
0x0310 shows Helmaroc (d_a_dk.cpp:252-268), the pirates and their ship (d_a_npc_p1.cpp:1302, d_a_obj_pirateship.cpp:431,485)
steps.notes: The Randomizer labels 0x0310 as the Hero's Clothes event; the code sets it at the postman. Differs from our reading, not checked further.

steps.label: Helmaroc carries Tetra over Outset
evidence: zelda_fly ordered from telescope_proc; 0x0001 set at its end: daNpc_Ls1_c::event_proc, d_a_npc_ls1.cpp:1620
steps.warn: Aryll's telescope progress is kept in the actor, not the save; a save between postman and zelda_fly replays the postman step (untested).

steps.label: Orca: talk about getting equipped
evidence: Ji1_EquipTalk on creation while 0x0001 on and 0x0108 off: d_a_npc_ji1.cpp:4779-4781; first talk sets 0x0108 (msg 0x965)

steps.label: Orca's training: the Hero's Sword
evidence: 5+ hits with 0x0001 on and 0x2F10 off sets 0x2F10 and gives dItemNo_SWORD_e: d_a_npc_ji1.cpp:1503, 3009-3016

steps.label: The forest: Tetra caught in the tree
evidence: look_tetra (A_mori) sets 0x0280 as it starts: d_event_manager.cpp:601

steps.label: Meeting Tetra; Aryll is taken
evidence: daTag_Event demo start sets 0x0101 (type 2) and 0x0E20 (type 3): d_a_tag_event.cpp:90-98
Outset layers: 0x0101 -> 9, 0x0E20 -> 2 (getLayerNo)

steps.label: Tetra and Quill on Outset
evidence: yuukaigo on arrival while 0x0E20 on, 0x2401 off: d_a_npc_zl1.cpp:312, sets 0x0802 at :1844

steps.label: The shield is gone from Grandma's wall

switches.why: LOOK_SHIELD's tag switch and spawn switch

evidence: TagEv type 0xA in LinkRM room 0 (params 0x02FF110A) hunts once 0x0E20 is on: d_a_tag_event.cpp:304-310
0x3202 at the end of LOOK_SHIELD: demoEndProc, d_a_tag_event.cpp:148-149
switch 0x11 in area 11 is on in every catalog save after the prologue

steps.label: Grandma gives the Hero's Shield
evidence: Grandma type 1 with 0x3202 and no shield sends Link to LinkRM spawn 201, layer 9: d_a_npc_ba1.cpp:1548-1568
get_shield.stb demo item table index 7 = Hero's Shield (d_a_demo00.cpp)
switch 0x15 in area 11 is on in every catalog save after the prologue

steps.label: Setting sail with the pirates
evidence: Tetra asks if Link is ready only with the shield; yes goes to sea spawn 0xCD: d_a_npc_zl1.cpp:1008-1016, 2192-2206
departure.stb demo data: flag table index 5 = 0x2401; event list EventFlag 0x2401

steps.label: On deck, Tetra sends Link to Niko
evidence: message 0x1005 sets 0x0810: d_a_npc_zl1.cpp:2203
steps.notes: Optional: only if Link talks to Tetra on deck (message 0x1005). Off in the whole playthrough catalog.

steps.label: Niko's rope test
evidence: compiled d_a_npc_p2.rel: onEventBit(0x0720) in demo_jump (.text+0x1E94), onEventBit(0x0710) in demo_goal (.text+0x28C0)

steps.label: The Spoils Bag from the hold's chest
evidence: chest event DEFAULT_TREASURE; Niko's treasure_wait waits for an event end (compiled d_a_npc_p2.rel)
steps.notes: Which chest flag in area 13 (Asoko) records the opened chest is not read yet.

steps.label: Tetra shouts: the Forsaken Fortress
evidence: P2B_ARRIVE_MAJYU (message 0x102B); compiled d_a_npc_p2.rel: onEventBit(0x0808) in demo_arrive (.text+0x2ADC)
0x0704: dLib_setFirstMsg in Niko's getMsg on the first talk after 0x0808 (.text+0x1660, msg 0x1029)
steps.notes: 0x0704 is set only if Link talks to Niko after the call (on in the catalog).

steps.label: Tetra calls Link over at the fortress
evidence: ooi: walk-up, d_a_npc_zl1.cpp:2233-2240; sets 0x0804 at :1850

steps.label: Launched into the Forsaken Fortress
evidence: majyuu_shinnyuu: walk-up, d_a_npc_zl1.cpp:2244-2257; sets 0x0801 at :1860
sword taken away in the first fortress stage: d_s_play.cpp:1370

steps.label: Tetra's message through the gossip stone
evidence: TagHt2 type 5 with flag 0x0520 (message 0x044D) in MajyuE stage and majroom room 3: daTag_Hint_c::startProc, d_a_tag_hint.cpp:472-475
steps.seen: Clean-up seen on the next visit to Outset, which play first allows after Farore's Pearl (sailing limits).

unplaced.notes: On by the end of the prologue in the catalog (entry 03) but not placed in a step. Leads: 0x0004 daTag_Event type 1; 0x0301/0x0480 d_a_bk (Bokoblins); 0x0401 barrel / hint tag; 0x0402 d_a_himo3 (rope); 0x0820 Senza's nudge (d_a_npc_p1); 0x1401 Quill (d_a_npc_bm1). Next arc: 0x2580 (find_sister), 0x2E01 and 0x0F80 (meeting the King of Red Lions).
